reason: Flagged for human review because this transaction shows a high-severity amount mismatch where PO-1009 authorized INR 118,000.00 but INR 141,600.00 was invoiced, paid, and recorded with no change order to explain the INR 23,600.00 overage. Additional findings include duplicate invoice scans (INV-1009-A and INV-1009-B) for the same supplier invoice raising double-payment risk, and a missing goods receipt note preventing verification that the billed items were actually received.

findings.explanation: INV-1009-A and INV-1009-B are identical scans of the same supplier invoice PIS/2026/091 (same vendor, date 2026-07-15, amount INR 141,600.00, tax INR 21,600.00), creating a duplicate-submission and double-payment risk, though only a single matching payment (BNK-1009) is evidenced.
PO-1009 authorizes INR 118,000.00 but the invoices, bank payment, and ledger entry all record INR 141,600.00, an unexplained overage of INR 23,600.00 with no change order or PO amendment present.
No goods receipt note or delivery confirmation document exists anywhere in this transaction to independently verify that the goods/services billed and paid were actually received.
